video_title: Draymond Green & The Inside Guys' FINAL THOUGHTS before Finals Game 4 🚨| NBA Tip-Off

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the Knicks' need to respond in Game 4
quotes.excerpt: Ultimately you want to see how the Knicks are going to respond. They got punched in the mouth.
quotes.quote: Ultimately you want to see how the Knicks are going to respond. They got punched in the mouth. Karl-Anthony Towns who had been playing great kind of had Victor Wembanyama in handcuffs definitely emotionally. You lost that last game. Can you come back out and re-establish that in Game 4? That's what we need to see.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley on the Spurs' physical play against the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: The Spurs out-physicaled the New York Knicks and they play well.
quotes.quote: The Spurs they came out played aggressive especially this guy 7'5" took a lot of high percentage shots. Never thought I'd say this but the Spurs out-physicaled the New York Knicks and they play well. This guy 7'5" you can't do much with that. I like when he not only plays mean I like when he makes a mark.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Smith on the Knicks' failure to contain Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: You can't let that happen. The Knicks rallied from 12 down.
quotes.quote: I was disappointed that the Knicks did not knock the hell out of him to be honest with you. They knocked the hell out of Brunson twice. If you're the Knicks you cannot let that happen. The Knicks rallied from 12 down.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley on the Knicks' mistake playing small against Towns
quotes.excerpt: They're trying to take the Knicks advantage away putting little guys on Karl-Anthony Towns.
quotes.quote: If they're going to play a little guy they're trying to take the Knicks advantage away putting little guys on Karl-Anthony Towns. When they had Wembanyama guarding him he was playing well the first two games. They switch it up in Game 3 because when is their last line of defense and Karl-Anthony Towns they're like oh they're going to play a little guy on Cat let's give him the ball.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley on Jalen Brunson's shot volume
quotes.excerpt: He can't go from 20 to 27 shots a game. First of all because he's damn missing.
quotes.quote: He can't go from 20 to 27 shots a game. First of all because he's damn missing.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Smith on the Spurs' defensive strategy
quotes.excerpt: The Hawks played little guys on him though. Jonathan Kuminga was on him.
quotes.quote: The Hawks played little guys on him though. Jonathan Kuminga was on him. Yeah but they don't have Wembanyama back there and he averaged almost 10 assists a game.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Smith on the Knicks' approach to the Finals
quotes.excerpt: Dean Smith would say we're playing like golf. We're playing the course, we're not playing the opponent.
quotes.quote: Dean Smith would say we're playing like golf. We're playing the course, we're not playing the opponent. We have to do what we do well and consistently do that every single time. So two different approaches, two different wins.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley on the Knicks' poor starts in the Finals
quotes.excerpt: Mike Brown has got to say guys, I ain't there's nothing I can say to y'all anymore.
quotes.quote: Mike Brown has got to say guys, I ain't there's nothing I can say to y'all anymore. We're in Game 4 of the Finals, why the hell are we coming out flat? We're down double digits at the end of every first quarter. I don't understand that.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley on the need for Knicks to make adjustments
quotes.excerpt: The Spurs made the adjustment with Wembanyama putting him on and now I think it's up to the Knicks.
quotes.quote: The Spurs made the adjustment with Wembanyama putting him on and now I think it's up to the Knicks to make the adjustment because it's about matchups. You got to use Karl-Anthony Towns if they're going to play little munchkins on him.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Wembanyama's physical adjustment
quotes.excerpt: I think what he's done is he's adjusted to the physicality.
quotes.quote: I think what he's done is he's adjusted to the physicality. First game he's rolling down the paint, they're tagging him, they're bumping him, they're throwing him around. Second game they started off, they're bumping, they're tagging, they're throwing him around. He upped the physicality and the Knicks is not going the other way. They're not tagging as much as they were because he's brought the physicality.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Smith on Stefan Castle's impact on Brunson
quotes.excerpt: The biggest thing that I've seen also with Brunson struggling shooting is Stefan Castle has picks him up.
quotes.quote: The biggest thing that I've seen also with Brunson struggling shooting is Stefan Castle has picks him up. 94 feet. He is wearing him down throughout the game and his physicality. I said this the other night, there's only about two or three guys in the league who is as physical a basketball player at the guard position as Brunson. He is one of them and he takes the challenge defensively which most guys just take it offensively and I think that has been a turning point in this series just as much as anything else.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Smith on the Knicks' failure to protect Brunson
quotes.excerpt: You cannot let them knock the hell out of your best player like they did.
quotes.quote: But also I was disappointed in the Knicks the other night. You cannot let them knock the hell out of your best player like they did and let them get away with that. Somebody on the Knicks got to knock the hell out of Wembanyama or Castle. You got to always protect your best player and they are not protecting Brunson. They can't let Wembanyama and Castle hit him like that.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley on the importance of full-game execution
quotes.excerpt: What matters is the entire game. You're establishing that the entire game.
quotes.quote: What matters is the entire game. You're establishing that the entire game so when you get down to the stretch you're in that position. So often times you get to the end of the game and people want to point to a play like Victor Wembanyama and say that play lost the game. It's like no, those turnovers in the first half matter as well.

quotes.speaker: Kenny Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenny Smith on the importance of defensive details
quotes.excerpt: Paying attention to the detail because when the last minute of the game when we say.
quotes.quote: And I would say again, paying attention to the detail because when the last minute of the game when we say if we're sending the guy baseline and you come over and help, I have no idea if you're back there but I have to believe that you're there and so I'm going to trust my teammates and pay attention to the details.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley on Jalen Brunson's need to pass
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson's got to pass the ball. He's got 81 points on 80 shots in three games.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson's got to pass the ball. He's got 81 points on 80 shots in three games. That's crazy. That's crazy. He has to feel the game out. When you're used to getting the ball you come out, you take those first three shots. If those three shots going in I'm going berserk. If they don't go in I'll let the game come to me, I'll get others involved.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley on Stefan Castle's physical defense
quotes.excerpt: Castle ain't no normal dude. Jalen is so strong for a little dude.
quotes.quote: He has to adjust because Castle ain't no normal dude. Jalen is so strong for a little dude. Man this Castle dude is a grown ass man. So those that's why his numbers aren't good. Jalen's not shooting the ball well but it's because of Castle.
